scope: All 612 AMD64 runtime ranges scanned linearly plus direct call targets from decoded prefixes. SetHelpFile host disassembly, selected leaf return-value C and limited direct IAT/data/indirect sites.
limitations: Five linear scans end before range end. Unwind fragments and direct calls can mark interior addresses. Code and data in linear decoding need CFG review. Source coverage is limited to 12 two-instruction leaves. Calls and data are selected, non-exhaustive. Indirect targets still require evidence; C models omit unverified ABI types.
